_comment: Built-in sample catalog. Set CatalogUrl in %APPDATA%\RewindTogether\launcher.json (or Diagnostics > Settings) to a hosted copy of this file to publish updates. Each entry: id, name, author, description, version, type (ue4ss-lua | pak | logicmod), url (https, may be empty = not downloadable yet), sha256 (required when url is set), size, homepage, and optional folder (UE4SS folder name when it differs from id).

mods.name: Rewind Together
mods.author: Rewind Together team
mods.description: Co-op multiplayer for Retro Rewind. Open your video store to friends over Steam - no port forwarding, no IP addresses. Needs UE4SS.
